feature.description: Every business-logic entry point routes through a graph orchestrator (today LangGraph) so shared concerns - safety, auth, audit, classification - live in one place and propagate automatically to every entry point. Encoded as engineering rule v4-043. Currently violated by /classify endpoint.

story.name: Codify graph-orchestration rule and enforce at check-in
story.description: Engineering rule v4-043 + a pre-commit scanner that rejects any new business-logic entry point that does not invoke through the graph. Existing violators (/classify) get tracking bugs and refactor stories.

requirement.requirement: Every operational entry point in ChatHealthy.ai Python services MUST invoke business logic through a single graph orchestrator. Shared concerns - safety, auth, audit, classification - are graph nodes; updating a shared concern propagates to every entry point in one place. Parallel paths that bypass the graph and call shared services directly are not permitted.
requirement.name: Route all Python service entry points through single graph orchestrator for core

requirement.requirement: Engineering rule v4-043 codifies the graph-orchestration rule. preCommitScan.py gains a new executor 'graph_entry_check' that AST-scans specified scan_dirs for FastAPI/Flask route handlers (functions decorated with @app.{post,get,put,delete,patch} or @router.* equivalents) whose body does not contain a call matching <StateGraph_var>.invoke(...). Permitted exceptions: handlers marked '# graph-exempt' AND paired by a risk_acceptance.json entry. Existing violator /classify (Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py:382) is tracked by BUG-ARCH-GRAPH-001 and refactored under a follow-on story. The scanner addition is tracked by BUG-ARCH-GRAPH-002.
requirement.name: Add 'graph_entry_check' to preCommitScan.py for route handler StateGraph.invoke

epic.name: UX
epic.description: Cross-component user experience concerns that span multiple business components.

feature.name: Cross Component Timers
feature.description: Timers that indicate progress to the user across FindCare, EvaluateCare, and other components.

story.description: One consistent timer must be placed in the same place on the screen across all business components and behave in the same way.

requirement.requirement: Timer keeps last second count until it is invoked again.
requirement.name: Timer retains last second count until next invocation

requirement.requirement: Timer MUST always be in the same place on the screen.
requirement.name: Timer fixed in consistent screen position

requirement.requirement: Timer MUST NOT stop even if a user modal dialog box is opened or some other control is active.
requirement.name: Timer continues running during modal dialogs or active controls

requirement.requirement: In non-production environments, all timed events MUST be logged to MongoDB in the correct environment.
requirement.name: Log all timed events to MongoDB in correct environment for non-production

story.name: Anchor Timer

epic.name: Shared Services
epic.description: Backend shared services and infrastructure used by all products.

feature.name: Backend Shared Services and Infrastructure
feature.description: Backend shared services that support FindCare: push notifications, activity audit, request logging, CORS, URL validation, tool routing, lead capture, unknown question handling, consent framework, about content, safety IP locking, debug logging, embedding infrastructure, session tokens, and cross-domain provider location. Created during code audit 2026-04-10.

story.description: Push notifications via SparkPost, activity audit trail to MongoDB, chat history formatting, request logging middleware, CORS security policy, welcome endpoint.

requirement.requirement: System must send push email notifications for lead/activity events via SparkPost when configured.
requirement.name: Send push email notifications for lead/activity events via SparkPost if enabled

requirement.requirement: GET /welcome must return the system welcome message.
requirement.name: GET /welcome returns system welcome message

requirement.requirement: System must persist significant activity records to MongoDB via commitSignificantActivity.
requirement.name: Persist significant activity records to MongoDB with commitSignificantActivity

requirement.requirement: System must truncate and normalize chat history before injecting into tool calls (max 500 chars per message).
requirement.name: Truncate and normalize chat history for tool calls (max 500 chars per message)

requirement.requirement: HTTP request logging middleware must log method, path, status code, elapsed ms, and client IP for every request.
requirement.name: Log method, path, status, elapsed ms, and client IP for each HTTP request

story.name: Core backend infrastructure — notifications, audit, logging, CORS

story.description: Three-stage URL validation (HEAD check, AI content verification, Google search correction) with TTL cache. Defangs broken URLs in markdown text and tool results. Prevents users from clicking broken links.

requirement.requirement: URLGuardian must validate URLs via HEAD request with redirect following. Broken URLs detected, redirects resolved.
requirement.name: Validate URLs via HEAD request with redirect following

requirement.requirement: URLGuardian must validate URLs in tool result dicts (links key). Broken links removed, redirects updated.
requirement.name: Validate and update URLs in tool results; remove broken, update redirected links

requirement.requirement: URLGuardian must validate URLs in markdown text. Broken markdown links defanged (text kept, link removed). Broken bare URLs left as plain text.
requirement.name: Validate markdown URLs; defang broken links; leave broken bare URLs as plain

requirement.requirement: URLGuardian must use AI content verification (Claude Haiku) to confirm reachable URLs show expected content. Pages with wrong content treated as broken.
requirement.name: AI content verification for reachable URLs using Claude Haiku

requirement.requirement: URLGuardian must attempt Google search correction for broken URLs, then AI-verify the top result matches intent.
requirement.name: Search-correct broken URLs and AI-verify top result matches intent

story.name: URL Guardian — validate and sanitize URLs in LLM responses

story.description: CORS restricted to chathealthy.ai domains and localhost. No wildcard origins.

requirement.requirement: CORS allow_origins must include only chathealthy.ai domains. Localhost via allow_origin_regex only.
requirement.name: Restrict CORS allow_origins to chathealthy.ai; localhost via allow_origin_regex

story.name: CORS security policy

story.description: GET /session generates a signed session token using FindCare x509 cert. Client stores in memory, passes on cross-component calls (e.g., to EvaluateCare).

requirement.requirement: GET /session must return a signed session token with origin=FindCare. Falls back to unsigned token if cert unavailable.
requirement.name: GET /session returns signed token with origin=FindCare; fallback to unsigned if

story.name: Session token generation for cross-component calls

story.description: Pydantic-validated allowlist tool dispatch. Only registered tools can be called. GOV-004: 'The model may suggest. The system must decide.'

requirement.requirement: ToolRouter must maintain an explicit allowlist registry. Only registered tools can be dispatched.
requirement.name: Maintain allowlist registry; dispatch only to registered tools

requirement.requirement: ToolRouter must validate tool inputs via Pydantic models before calling handlers. Invalid inputs rejected with error.
requirement.name: ToolRouter validates inputs via Pydantic, rejects invalid with error

requirement.requirement: ToolRouter must handle both Anthropic tool_use blocks and OpenAI normalized tool calls, injecting chat_history for tools that need it.
requirement.name: ToolRouter supports Anthropic tool_use, OpenAI calls & injects chat_history as-e

story.name: Tool Router — GOV-004 allowlist enforcement

story.description: Record user contact details with two-tier consent: verbatim transcript, de-identified summary, or contact-only. Dedup by email. Delegates to ConsentService.

requirement.requirement: If consent_verbatim is true, full chat history is stored with the lead record.
requirement.name: Store full chat history with lead if consent_verbatim is true

requirement.requirement: If consent_summary is true (not verbatim), conversation is summarized and de-identified before storage.
requirement.name: Summarize and de-identify conversation before storage if consent_summary is true

requirement.requirement: record_user_details must accept email, name, notes, message, and consent flags via Pydantic-validated input.
requirement.name: Accept email, name, notes, message, consent flags via Pydantic validation

story.name: Lead Capture — contact record creation with consent (UAT Feature 6)

story.description: Classify unanswerable questions into healthcare_capability, medical_advice, or irrelevant. Present consent template. Record with de-identification if user consents.

requirement.requirement: Response templates must exist for three question classes: healthcare_capability, medical_advice, irrelevant.
requirement.name: Response templates for healthcare_capability, medical_advice, irrelevant classes

requirement.requirement: If user consents, chat history must be de-identified before recording. Question and class stored in AboutUs.AboutSkip.
requirement.name: De-identify chat history on consent; store Q/class in AboutUs.AboutSkip

requirement.requirement: record_unknown_question must accept question, question_class, and consent flag via Pydantic-validated input.
requirement.name: record_unknown_question accepts question, class, and consent via Pydantic input

story.name: Unknown Question Handling (UAT Feature 12)

story.description: FindCareService.get_provider_location returns provider lat/lng/address for a given NPI. Called by EvaluateCareFacade for clinical trial travel time calculations.

requirement.requirement: get_provider_location must return lat, lng, and formatted address for a given NPI from the providers collection.
requirement.name: Return lat, lng, and formatted address for NPI from providers collection

story.name: Cross-domain provider location for travel calculations

story.description: Two-tier consent: Tier 1 = verbatim transcript, Tier 2 = de-identified summary. ConsentService summarizes via Claude Haiku and de-identifies via HIPAA Safe Harbor.

requirement.requirement: summarize_conversation must produce a 2-3 sentence summary of chat history via Claude Haiku.
requirement.name: Summarize chat history in 2-3 sentences using Claude Haiku

requirement.requirement: de_identify must strip PII from chat history in-place per HIPAA Safe Harbor requirements using Claude Haiku.
requirement.name: Strip PII from chat history per HIPAA Safe Harbor using Claude Haiku

story.name: Consent Framework — two-tier HIPAA consent (UAT Feature 7)

story.description: Static content service for about intents. Returns Skip Snow professional context with LinkedIn link, and ChatHealthy business plan and principles.

requirement.requirement: get_skip_snow_context must return summary, LinkedIn content, and connect info with markdown links rendered verbatim.
requirement.name: Return summary, LinkedIn content, connect info with markdown links rendered verb

requirement.requirement: get_chathealthy_context must return business_plan and anthropic_principles from pre-loaded ME context.
requirement.name: Return business_plan and anthropic_principles from ME context in get_chathealthy

story.name: About Content — Skip Snow and ChatHealthy context (UAT Feature 4)

story.description: DebugLogger persists chat call metadata (IP, message preview, tokens, errors) to {ENV}_Debug.chat_calls. On error, de-identified chat history is included.

requirement.requirement: log_chat must persist IP, message preview (200 chars), history length, tool loop iterations, token counts, response preview, and error to MongoDB. On error, de-identified chat history included.
requirement.name: Persist chat metadata and de-identified history to MongoDB on error

story.name: Debug Logging — chat call metadata to MongoDB

story.description: EmbeddingClient provides text-embedding-3-large (provider vector search), text-embedding-3-small (specialty matching), and Claude Haiku query expansion (regex pipeline).

requirement.requirement: get_query_embedding must return a vector from text-embedding-3-large for provider vector search.
requirement.name: get_query_embedding returns text-embedding-3-large vector for provider search

requirement.requirement: get_specialty_vector must return a vector from text-embedding-3-small for specialty matching.
requirement.name: Return text-embedding-3-small vector for specialty matching

requirement.requirement: expand_query_terms must return 2-5 keyword stems via Claude Haiku for regex pipeline matching against Specialization and Display Name fields.
requirement.name: expand_query_terms returns 2-5 keyword stems for regex matching on fields

story.name: Embedding Infrastructure — centralized AI embedding and query expansion
